defects_found_and_corrected_before_this_: source-noun collision such as 'entry in the ... entry'
unquoted delivery-concordance labels after 'maps the wording'
same-surname synthetic labels such as 'Vale-Vale delivery'
redundant modifier composition such as 'lower lower-desk' and semantically stray 'lower clock-room'
remaining_style_characteristics: The corpus intentionally uses formal scorer and review-register prose rather than conversational commentary.
Long nominal descriptions are retained because resolving them is part of the registered identity-binding burden.
Governing law statements repeat when the same rule is a true shared premise; non-rule generated text remains unique.
claim_boundary: This is an assistant review of a deterministic private sample, not an independent native-speaker annotation study. It supports request readiness but cannot by itself support a publication claim of human-equivalent naturalness.
